title: 第7单元：化学与生物安全
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/06_Module 7 — Chemical & Biological Safety.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/06_Module 7 — Chemical & Biological Safety/src.py

points.K10: 高风险操作靠工程控制
points.K11: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回

shots.scene: 欣欣站在试剂柜和生物安全柜之间，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a chemical storage cabinet and a biological safety cabinet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学和生物危害的日常操作。
overlay: 第7单元：化学与生物安全

shots.scene: 试剂柜、通风橱、生物安全柜、手套箱、报告单五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a chemical cabinet, a fume hood, a biological safety cabinet, a glove box and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 储存、台面、生物、高风险、报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一瓶酸放进装碱的柜子里
shots.prompt_en: Wearing a lab coat and goggles, the young male student puts a bottle with a corrosive pictogram into a cabinet already holding other corrosive bottles of a different type.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手把酸放进了碱的柜子。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜前，看到柜内点着火焰的图标，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns at an icon of an open flame inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 隔壁，有人想在安全柜里点火。

shots.scene: 老周把阿杰和小研叫到一起，指着两个柜子
shots.prompt_en: The older man gathers the young male student and the female graduate student and points at the two cabinets.
shots.narration: 老周说：小习惯，决定大安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 今天就从这些小事讲起。

shots.scene: 积灰的文件夹打叉，旁边实验台打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dusty binder crossed out with a red X next to a tidy lab bench with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不在文件夹里，在实验台上。

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶、移液、丢手套三个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons: storing a solvent bottle, transferring liquid with a pipette and discarding a glove into a bin. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么放、怎么倒、怎么丢，都是选择。

shots.scene: 化学品柜分成几格，各贴不同危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: A chemical storage cabinet divided into sections, each marked with a different hazard pictogram: flammable, corrosive, oxidizer. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品按主要危险类别分区放。

shots.scene: 酸和碱的图标靠在一起冒热浪，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An acid icon and a base icon side by side giving off heat waves, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碱放一起，漏了会剧烈放热。

shots.scene: 含氰试剂和酸的图标靠在一起冒骷髅云，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cyanide reagent icon and an acid icon side by side with a skull cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含氰试剂碰到酸，会放出剧毒气体。

shots.scene: 小研把酸瓶移到单独的酸柜
shots.prompt_en: Wearing gloves, the female graduate student moves the acid bottle into a separate acid cabinet.
shots.narration: 不相容的，一定分开存放。

shots.scene: 开放货架上一排溶剂瓶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A row of flammable solvent bottles on an open shelf, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体超10加仑，不能放开放架。

shots.scene: 黄色防火安全柜，门自动关上
shots.prompt_en: A yellow flammable storage cabinet with self-closing doors and a flammable warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 要放进合格的防火安全柜。

shots.scene: 更大的专用库房图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dedicated flammable storage room with a warning sign on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 量更大，就要专用库房。

shots.scene: 器皿放在通风橱前沿，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Glassware placed right at the front edge of a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 器皿放在通风橱前沿，很危险。

shots.scene: 前沿处风速箭头很短，气体飘向人脸图标
shots.prompt_en: Short airflow arrows at the hood edge while a vapor cloud drifts toward a face icon. No people.
shots.narration: 前沿风很弱，气体会跑到脸前。

shots.scene: 小研把器皿推到通风橱里面操作
shots.prompt_en: Wearing goggles and gloves, the female graduate student pushes the glassware well inside the fume hood before working.
shots.narration: 往里放，至少离视窗6英寸。

shots.scene: 手臂快速进出通风橱的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of arms moving rapidly in and out of a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手臂别快速进出。

shots.scene: 视窗拉得太高的通风橱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its sash raised too high, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 视窗别开得太高。

shots.scene: 通风橱后部堆满杂物，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with clutter piled against the back baffles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 后面别堆杂物，挡住风口。

shots.scene: 三只不同颜色的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Three waste containers in different colors with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 废液按相容性分开收集。

shots.scene: 混在一起的废液桶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A waste container with mixed incompatible streams, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 混在一起，风险高、处置也贵。

shots.scene: 阿杰倒完废液随手盖紧
shots.prompt_en: Wearing goggles and gloves, the young male student caps the waste container right after adding waste.
shots.narration: 倒完随手盖紧。

shots.scene: 装到警戒线的桶被推车运走
shots.prompt_en: A waste container filled to its marked line being taken away on a cart. No people.
shots.narration: 装到约75%就移走，绝不装满。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜和它的空气气幕箭头
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with downward airflow arrows forming an air curtain at the front opening. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜靠气幕保护人和样品。

shots.scene: 柜内火焰冲乱气流箭头，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An open flame inside the biological safety cabinet with swirling broken airflow arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里点本生灯，热气流冲破气幕。

shots.scene: 火焰图标旁的着火警示
shots.prompt_en: A flammable warning sign next to the biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 还可能引起火灾。

shots.scene: 小研用一次性接种环和电热灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Wearing a lab coat and gloves, the female graduate student uses a disposable inoculation loop and a small electric loop sterilizer inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 改用一次性接种环或电热灭菌器。

shots.scene: 喷一下马上擦掉的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of spraying disinfectant and immediately wiping it off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 喷一下就擦，等于没消毒。

shots.scene: 台面保持湿润，旁边时钟
shots.prompt_en: A wet disinfected surface inside a biological safety cabinet with a clock beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 1比10漂白剂，湿润5到10分钟。

shots.scene: 芽孢图标旁，酒精瓶打叉、含氯消毒剂打勾
shots.prompt_en: Next to a spore icon, an alcohol bottle crossed out and a chlorine disinfectant bottle with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 芽孢类酒精无效，要用新配含氯剂。

shots.scene: 生物废物袋放进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard bag being placed into an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物出门前，先高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 拧紧的废液瓶炸裂图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tightly capped waste bottle cracking under pressure, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶盖拧紧，会在锅里炸裂。

shots.scene: 瓶盖松开、袋口留缝，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a loosened cap and a biohazard bag with its top left slightly open, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶盖松开，袋口留缝。

shots.section_title: 高风险操作靠工程控制
shots.scene: 手套箱、隔离器、面屏、阻燃服四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a glove box, an isolator, a face shield and a flame-resistant lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险操作，主要靠工程控制。
overlay: 高风险操作靠工程控制

shots.section_title: 高风险操作靠工程控制
shots.scene: 自燃危险象形图，旁边手套箱和两个人形
shots.prompt_en: A pyrophoric hazard pictogram next to a glove box icon and two person icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 自燃物：手套箱、阻燃服、结伴做。

shots.section_title: 高风险操作靠工程控制
shots.scene: 细胞毒性标志和负压隔离器
shots.prompt_en: A toxic hazard pictogram next to a negative-pressure isolator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞毒性物质：负压隔离、密闭转移。

shots.section_title: 高风险操作靠工程控制
shots.scene: 高活性物质图标和带气闸的隔离器
shots.prompt_en: A high-potency substance icon next to an isolator with an airlock and a powered respirator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高活性药物：气闸隔离器、多点去污。

shots.section_title: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回
shots.scene: 黑色缎带和空白日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A black mourning ribbon next to a blank calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 2008年，一所大学发生致死事故。
overlay: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回

shots.section_title: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回
shots.scene: 自燃试剂图标遇空气起火，旁边没有阻燃服，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pyrophoric reagent icon igniting on contact with air, next to a missing flame-resistant coat outline, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 塑料注射器转移有机锂，没穿阻燃服。

shots.section_title: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回
shots.scene: 注射器图标裂开，火焰蔓延到衣物图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked plastic syringe with flames spreading to a synthetic clothing icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 注射器失效，化纤衣服着火致死。

shots.section_title: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回
shots.scene: 一本空白安全规范书被翻开更新
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety standards book being opened and updated with a new page. No people.
shots.narration: 这起事故改变了学术界安全标准。

shots.section_title: 省掉一步，代价无法挽回
shots.scene: 欣欣低头默哀，然后抬头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot bows its head in silence, then looks up seriously.
shots.narration: 省掉一步，后果无法挽回。

shots.scene: 储藏间角落里积灰的玻璃瓶
shots.prompt_en: Dusty unlabeled glass containers forgotten in the corner of a storage closet. No people.
shots.narration: 几十年前，一批汞被遗忘在储藏间。

shots.scene: 装修工具碰倒瓶子，银色珠子散落
shots.prompt_en: An icon of renovation tools knocking over a container with small silver beads scattering. No people.
shots.narration: 2019年常规装修，把它碰洒了。

shots.scene: 没有防护的人形图标靠近汞珠，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person icon without protective equipment approaching the silver beads, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 清理人员没防护，几人尿汞升高。

shots.scene: 定时炸弹图标
shots.prompt_en: A ticking time bomb icon next to a dusty bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 没人管的旧库存，就是定时炸弹。

shots.scene: 匿名信箱和实名表格两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an anonymous suggestion box and a blank named report form. No people.
shots.narration: 匿名和实名，报告渠道都要有。

shots.scene: 王老师很快回复阿杰的报告
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator quickly replies to the young male student about his report, giving a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 快速反馈，让人知道被重视。

shots.scene: 组会上老周表扬报告人，大家鼓掌
shots.prompt_en: At a group meeting, the older man praises the student who reported a problem while others clap.
shots.narration: 公开感谢报告人，不责备。

shots.scene: 整改清单上一项项打勾到底
shots.prompt_en: A blank corrective action list with every item checked off to the end. No people.
shots.narration: 每项整改都跟踪到完成。

shots.scene: 纠正和预防两个图标：创可贴和齿轮
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a bandage for correction and a gear for prevention. No people.
shots.narration: 纠正止住问题，预防改变系统。

shots.scene: 日历翻过几页，小研回来复查
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by, then the female graduate student returns to recheck an improved setup with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 6个月后回头查，看管不管用。

shots.scene: 险情报告单越来越多，严重事故图标越来越少
shots.prompt_en: A growing stack of near-miss report forms next to a shrinking serious accident icon. No people.
shots.narration: 险情报得多，大事故反而少。

shots.scene: 一个安静无声的实验室图标，问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a silent lab with a muted speaker symbol and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 从不报险情，是把风险藏起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分区的试剂柜旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical cabinet divided into hazard sections.
shots.narration: 分区存放，易燃超量进防火柜。

shots.scene: 通风橱和废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood and a capped waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 通风橱往里放，废液分类加盖。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜、时钟、灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biological safety cabinet, a clock and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里不点火，消毒够时间，灭菌松盖。

shots.scene: 手套箱和隔离器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glove box and an isolator. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险操作，靠工程控制。

shots.scene: 报告单和验证循环图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a near-miss report form and a check mark loop. No people.
shots.narration: 险情多报，整改要验证。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老周在整洁实验室挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student, the young male student and the older man in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 小习惯守住大安全，下次见！
